summary: FRONTEND-ONLY validation of all 5 chambers (Clarity /clarity, Resonance /resonance/chamber, Mirror /mirror-archive/chamber, Spiral /spiral, Paige /presence/paige) with 2-turn anchor-word recall and a post-reply reload. Initial loads, welcome messages, multi-turn streaming chat, IN-SESSION memory recall, and voice toggle UI ALL WORK for the 4 streaming chambers (Clarity/Resonance/Spiral/Paige). Mirror's send button has no data-testid which made automated send fragile, but chat input/UI renders fine. CRITICAL BUG: the newly-added 'continuing where you left off' resume indicator + transcript restoration does NOT trigger after reload in ANY of the 5 chambers. After reload each chamber shows a fresh welcome with status 'thread open' (Paige) or no resumed indicator at all (Clarity/Resonance/Mirror/Spiral); the prior turns' anchor words are absent from the restored body. Waited up to 38s on reload — backend never returned resumed=true.

minor.issue: Returns 400 intermittently during stream playback (logged in console as '[speakStream] segment failed: TTS request failed'). Does NOT block chat — chambers still function.

ui_bugs.issue: Textarea input and Send button lack data-testid attributes (unlike sibling chambers). Inconsistent with the V3.1 contract that 'all interactive elements have data-testid'. Recommend data-testid="mirror-input" and data-testid="mirror-send-btn".

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: After completing a real exchange and reloading the page, neither the resume indicator nor the restored transcript appears. Verified across Clarity, Resonance, Mirror, Spiral, and Paige. For Paige specifically the chamber-thread-status reads 'thread open' instead of 'continuing where you left off'; for the legacy chambers the *-resumed-indicator span is absent (resumed===false) and the message list contains only the fresh welcome. Backend reports 48/48 resume tests passing, so the disconnect is in the frontend → backend handshake on mount.

Likely RCA for the resume failure: PresenceChamber.jsx useEffect (line 139) and the legacy chambers' startSession all fire as soon as the component mounts using userId/userName from IdentityContext. On a fresh reload IdentityContext starts as null and hydrates asynchronously from /api/identity/recent — so /chat/start is first called with user_id=null, creating a brand-new session, then re-fires when identity hydrates (still produces a fresh session because the prior turn's user_id was a different ad-hoc id). Net result: backend never matches the previous open thread → resumed=false.

Console errors 'DataCloneError: Failed to execute postMessage on Window: Request object could not be cloned' originate from the Emergent iframe scaffolding (assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js) — they appear on Welcome voice attempts in Resonance/Mirror/Spiral/Paige but do not break chat flow. Likely safe to ignore; if owned, gate TTS calls behind user interaction.

action_items: PRIMARY: Fix resume-on-reload in all 5 chambers. Most likely root cause is identity-hydration timing — startSession fires with userId=null before IdentityContext loads /api/identity/recent, so the backend cannot match the previously-open thread. Either (a) gate startSession behind a 'identity ready' flag, (b) re-run startSession with abort+replace when userId transitions from null → real id and discard the null-id session, or (c) include a stable client/device cookie so the backend can resume even before identity hydrates.

Add data-testid='mirror-input' to the textarea and data-testid='mirror-send-btn' to the Send button in /app/frontend/src/components/MirrorArchive.jsx (lines 502 and 517) to keep parity with the other chambers and unblock automation.
Investigate the /api/tts/speak 400/502 errors during stream playback — non-blocking but noisy in the console for every assistant chunk.
Consider silencing or wrapping the emergent-main.js DataCloneError on Welcome voice attempts (or gating Welcome TTS behind first user click) so the console stays clean.
critical_code_review_comments: PresenceChamber.jsx line 139–166: useEffect depends on [config, presenceKey, userName, userId] and resets messages/sessionId/resumed unconditionally on every dependency change — so when IdentityContext hydrates after mount, the chamber discards the freshly-resumed thread it just received. This is the exact mechanism that breaks 'continuing where you left off'.

ClarityPod.jsx line 200–217: startSession reads userId/userName from local state and posts to /clarity/start. Same identity-timing concern — the first call after reload likely runs before useIdentity() rehydrates.
MirrorArchive.jsx (lines 502, 517): missing data-testids on input + send (already filed in ui_bugs).

Voice 'Welcome' auto-speak triggers a Window.postMessage clone of a Request object that the parent iframe scaffolding cannot serialize (assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js). Gate Welcome TTS behind first user interaction or use a plain ArrayBuffer payload.
Identity contract noted in iter_6 still holds — names auto-hydrate to 'David' (legacy-david-123); confirmed identity-badge shows 'David' on all chambers without re-prompting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend resume API per iter_6 backend run = 48/48 green. The new bug surfaces only at the FRONTEND mount-handshake. To repro: open any chamber, send 'My anchor word is FOO' → wait for assistant reply (~10-15 s for streaming chambers, ~10 s for Paige) → hard-reload page → expect '*-resumed-indicator' or chamber-thread-status='continuing where you left off' to be visible within 5–10 s. Observed: never resumes. Suggested first-fix area: PresenceChamber.jsx useEffect at line 139 dependency array + each legacy chamber's startSession trigger.
rca_of_the_issue: Resume-on-reload regression — RCA candidate: chambers call POST /<chamber>/start on mount using userId from IdentityContext, but IdentityContext is null on first render and hydrates async via /api/identity/recent. The first /start call therefore goes out with user_id=null and creates a NEW session; the backend cannot tie this to the prior anchor-word thread (which was tagged with the real legacy-david-123 id). When identity then hydrates, the useEffect re-fires (because userId/userName are deps), resets messages+sessionId+resumed to []/null/false, then issues a second /start — but this one is racing with potential pending writes and still does not see the original thread as 'open'. Net: resumed===false, messages.length===1 (welcome only), no indicator. Fix: defer the first /start until identity is hydrated, OR include a stable session/client cookie that the backend can use as a resume key independent of user_id.
